Land moves the repo's act/landed branch to the run's HEAD (making it from
the default branch the first time), which a person reads and merges by
hand. The worktree must be clean, the last check must have passed at
HEAD, and act/landed must be under HEAD: agent dream act rebase first if
it moved on. Act never touches the default branch and never pushes.

Usage:
  agent dream act land [flags]

Examples:
  agent dream act land

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for land

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
